commits.message:
fix(panel): a Panel's and a Padding's style is the ground under the whole block (rich-panel-ech) (#261)

* fix(panel): a Panel's and a Padding's style is the ground under the whole block (rich-panel-ech)

Style reached only the padding spaces, leaving the content and the frame
unstyled. As in Rich, the style is now applied under the content, and a
Panel's frame is its border style laid over it; title, subtitle and accessory
styles lay over the frame's instead of replacing it, so they no longer cut a
hole in the background on the border rows. docs/panel.md regains its Style
section.

* fix(padding,panel): expand narrows a Padding, rows always reach it; border text shares one style rule (rich-panel-ech)

Review (high) findings: expand:false left content rows ragged under a
full-width blank row; a string accessory on an unstyled panel drew with
NULL_STYLE beside an undefined frame; titleStyle/subtitleStyle JSDoc
still described replacement.
